raw.query: SELECT run_id, gpu_hours, p99_ttft_ms, p99_itl_ms, decode_worker_seconds FROM provenance.llm_run_summary WHERE run_id = 'planner:week_fc_p90'; -- numerator; denominator = 4 GPUs × window_span_s 483659.8 / 3600 = 537.400 GPU-h (from provenance.windows WHERE window_name='aggregate'); ratio = 518.6063 / 537.400
raw.evidence: Numerator from llm_run_summary.planner:week_fc_p90 = 518.6063 H100 GPU-h; denominator computed as TP2×2 (4 GPUs) × aggregate-window span 483,659.8 s = 537.400 GPU-h; 518.6063/537.400 = 0.96503 (0.965 at three decimals). TTFT p99 651 ms passes the SLA. v_cost_ratio has zero language-pool rows (its CTE filters on encoder_run_summary only), so the expected backing is mis-specified but the value is verifiable via llm_run_summary.
